scope: Source discovery plus manually recorded scoped coverage. Source signals alone do not prove runtime permissions or acceptance; consult coverageEvidence and the quality register. Regenerate after route/component changes.

coverageLegend.not-inspected: No per-page acceptance claim; earlier sampled evidence remains in the register.
coverageLegend.inspected: Reviewed, without a repair or completed acceptance claim.
coverageLegend.verified: See the page evidence and quality register for exact role, state and device limits.
coverageLegend.blocked: Concrete external dependency recorded in page evidence.
coverageLegend.not-applicable: Explicitly absent from the selected page/task region.
